targets.outcome_quote:
In summary, our findings replicated much of what Lim et al.
found in their study. There were no direct contradicting findings between our and their study; instead, there were contrasts in thematic
foci and analytical framing.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors summarize the replication as largely replicating the original, explicitly treating contrasts as supplementary thematic framing rather than contradictory results. This overall verdict decides the outcome.
